title-group.article-title: The shikimate branch point feeding enterobactin in Escherichia coli

sec.title: Results
sec.p: The last shikimate step was measured in vitro. AroC converts enolpyruvylshikimate phosphate to chorismate.
At the branch point, EntC converts chorismate to isochorismate.
An unrelated control enzyme was also tested: XyzA converts fooate to barate.
